title: Biofoundry
controls_hint: Tap visible tools, Jobs controls, optional specialist and cargo-run actions, and campaign choices; drag the map or tap +/− to zoom
about: Build a living factory beneath the earth. Dig tunnels, grow food, staff production lines, and awaken the Colossal Worm in a focused campaign before continuing into endless cargo runs.

controls.desc: Drag the map to pan; tap buildings to inspect them
Tap Pause to stop the simulation while keeping the Warren controls available
Tap tools, Jobs +/−, Pause, Help, Save, Load, and Menu
Tap a building to inspect it, or select a tool then tap open floor or rock
After the Worm awakens, tap Continue in Endless or Return to Menu

After the warren is secure, tap Breeding Pit choices to spend banked ingots on specialists; use an awakened Outpost for cargo runs, expand its hold and camp, install a survey rig for better ore yields, tune its resonance beacon for faster surveys, complete the Worm Road Charter to unlock the Wormbone toolkit and its bonus ingot cache, calibrate Deep Survey for a final yield boost, and keep scouting to fill repeatable Worm Road Archive pages; the first Archive page unlocks the stronger Archive Wayfinder carrier recipe at the Blacksmith, opens the Worm Road Relay across two active routes for a one-time ingot payout, and lets a completed route install a Signal Cache for ingots on every later haul, while miners and carriers auto-equip better gear and remote routes can enable Auto-return · Cargo only and Auto-resupply · Food only

controls_note: Pinch zoom is also supported on touch screens.
